name: ContextMeter
purpose: Context-window usage and cost of a conversation.
description: How much of the model's context window a conversation uses, and what it has cost. The compact style is a ring and percentage for the Prompt input; it opens a card with the bar, a breakdown (input, output, tools) and the cost. The bar style shows the same details inline. Part of the Agent kit.

used.notes: Figma: Used — tokens in the context window now

limit.notes: Figma: Limit — the model's context window in tokens

cost.notes: Figma: Cost — spend for this conversation, in `currency`

breakdown.notes: Optional split of `used` (input, output, cached …) shown in the details

variant.notes: Figma: Style. `compact` (default) — a ring and percentage for a prompt toolbar; details open on click. `bar` — label, bar and numbers inline, for side panels and settings.

warnAt.notes: Percentage at which the meter turns warning; error from 95%

placement.notes: Which way the compact details open; `up` suits a prompt input at the bottom of the screen

defaultOpen.notes: Start with the compact details open (docs and tests)

do: Format large numbers compactly (48.2K) and show cost in the person's currency.
Explain what happens when the window is full.
forbidden: Never block sending when the meter is full without saying why and what to do.
